title: tdh.sigproc.mmfilt.ui~
description: `tdh.sigproc.mmfilt.ui~` is a multimode audio-filter interface providing low-pass, high-pass, and band-pass filtering with controls for cutoff frequency, filter type, Q/bandwidth, and dry/wet balance. It accepts the signal to filter and outputs the filtered signal; use filter-type values 0, 1, or 2, and note that the Q control applies only to the band-pass filter.
